full_cell_tests.protocol: Measured drive cycle, nominal 80 to 20% SOC; repeated excitation, 0.15 s sampling, 24742.8 s elapsed; paper v4 Section 7.3 / Figure 11.
full_cell_tests.evidence: Same explicit LG M50LT model and Hallemans2025 study: Fig11 loads this drive-cycle MAT and the same fitted vector; v4 Section 7.3 identifies measured terminal voltage and Fig11 validation. Exact serialized-specimen chain to harvested OCP half-cells is not supplied.
full_cell_tests.format: Published measured t/i/v arrays, all rows and native precision retained; not instrument export or simulated model output.
full_cell_tests.current_convention: Source i retained: charge positive, discharge negative. Author Fig11 negates i to supply PyBaMM's discharge-positive current. u is not used as voltage or substituted for measured i.
full_cell_tests.temperature_definition: No cell/ambient temperature array. Paper Table 4 specifies 25 degC for EIS; this is not assigned to drive-cycle rows.

processing.source_position: source_record is one-based MATLAB array index
processing.changes: Extract t/i/v without resampling, smoothing or unit changes; classify mode from i sign. Blank T/cycle/step remain unavailable.

omitted_fields.u: Current-like array; precise measured/commanded/processed meaning unresolved. Retained only in original MAT.
